question: What is the current MATLAB release?
answer: Based on MATLAB R2026b, announced by MathWorks on 24 September 2026 [1]. R2026b is the current release as of November 13, 2026, and it adds new products such as Simulink Variant Manager, Visual Inspection Toolbox, and Polyspace Test Server [1]. A MATLAB Blog post says it was released on 23rd September 2026 [2], while the MathWorks press release is dated 24 September 2026 [1]. The sources don't explain the one-day difference. The previous release was R2026a [5].
